edge_case_rules.None_opaque: Provider None conflates None/unsupported/undefined; preserve opaque reason and any unexposed native Tensor paths. Scalar type tags never supply scalar values.
edge_case_rules.alias: Retain G1 formal alias annotations as static constraints. Same-provider allocation-group counts are only observations; TensorID/impl/storage tokens are never equated across ETO and event-tree providers, and no runtime alias or content equality follows.
edge_case_rules.empty_list: Retain the empty list slot and zero Tensor leaves. Formal TensorList/optional semantics come from G1 schema; never invent one Tensor port.
edge_case_rules.randomness: No operator-name random classifier. Schema/generator observations do not close implicit RNG/global state, deterministic output or hidden effects; retain the original effect frontier.
edge_case_rules.schema_missing: Retain provider facts and original denominator; no generic native ABI entitlement without original schema/formal port contract. Generic registered namespaces remain in domain; implementation/effects may stay Unknown.
edge_case_rules.zero_dim: A direct TensorMetadata with sizes=[] is 0D, not None/undefined or empty container. It still needs the same exact native Tensor path.

matching_contract: Keep every tree row and ordered input in the denominator, including unknown schema and absent RF. Correlation is never substituted for RF even when numbers coincide.

Within the exact Run/process/artifact group: unique positive tree correlation -> unique CPU Kineto External id -> its Record function id -> unique positive ETO rf_id; independently verify tree RF-thread against ETO tid.

Use original Kineto event ordinal and original ETO nodes ordinal. Verify mapped control parents and already-key-joined names/overloads/ordered structure; never use name/time/shape to choose a candidate.
Match metadata direction=inputs and original boxed path. Preserve chunk logical URI/raw SHA/local archive mapping/original line and slot; repeat references are distinct ports.
Missing source/schema/unsupported structures remain per-row/per-port frontiers. Duplicate keys and known parent/thread/path contradictions reject publication; they are not absence frontiers.

minimal_implementation_plan.API: Consume G1 capture-model, native bundle-partitions and schema-contracts through existing readers/selected_records; no repeated import/all-bundle decode.
One bounded source join factory with exact input artifact receipts and Run/process. Return original-ID/path binding/frontier evidence, not a second graph.

Join G1 original native instance/schema binding to the supplied execution OccurrenceEvidenceBinding and NativeInputRef. No canonical input supplied means explicit frontier, not a synthesized reference.
Recompute exact producer/ordinal/ordered path and metadata source under an explicit input-metadata capability, including Unknown-B/zero-Tensor cases; never allow a summary pass flag.

model_contract.G1_boundary: G1 ordinary native ValueGraph/EvidenceGraph/schema artifacts are authority for their existing IDs; import_capture still declares canonical_program_snapshot OPEN. Do not confuse them with an already supplied ProgramGraph/Execution Snapshot.
model_contract.binding_rule: Verify supplied canonical producer/source/basis against exact G1/raw preimages; then add metadata evidence to the existing input occurrence. Do not parse opaque IDs or instantiate a candidate NativeInputRef to fill missing canonical inputs.
model_contract.candidate_layer: Raw ProviderFactReference joins only. No NativeInputRef instance, ObjectID, LogicalVersion or new graph authority is constructed by this audit.
canonical_inputs_required: Exact ProgramGraph and Execution snapshot identities
Existing actual OccurrenceEvidenceBinding for the original ETO OperationInstanceID and original ordinal
Existing NativeInputRef(boundary, entry, position) and ValueOccurrence selected by original formal/boxed path
G1 original native EEG instance/provider-reference/schema-binding and selected partition row provenance
model_contract.qualification_planes: A input structure/metadata, B Python object identity, C geometry/allocation, and D content/state/ready remain independent. Unknown B stays Unknown. This cut grants no C/D and touches no old1901 Run.
model_contract.reuse_G1: Reuse the third agent's same-capture import_capture(schema_contracts=True,bundle_partitions=True,os_interface_work=True), --max-calls512. Do not call import_capture again or scan OS; Root supplies its capture-model/native bundle-partitions/schema-contracts manifests when ready.

next_root_gate.after_G1: Reuse the saved decoded/raw same-capture facts and G1 canonical outputs. Gate one positive existing-port association and one in-memory wrong-native-producer candidate against the independent checker; no new capture/import/OS sweep or test matrix.
next_root_gate.now: Run this one whitelist audit during G1; expect one complete row inventory, exact read-byte accounting, concrete frontiers and no contradictions. It remains candidate-only.
next_root_gate.qualification_limit: Metadata association only; Python identity/content/state/ready and full-model closure remain OPEN.

output_contract: Only audit.py and PLAN.json are new analysis files. Root-reviewed audit updates only this PLAN.json audit section, preserving its prepared-plan SHA; source and old artifacts are read-only.
